global_history: Born from the fallout of the Xylos Collapse, The Gamma Hold stands as a leaden monolith amidst the screaming auroras of Aura-507. Once a bustling refinery, it became a gilded cage after the Great Melt-Down. Now, its humming halls are the exclusive domain of the Zinc-Saints and their cold, unthinking drones. Beyond the obsidian-glass of the Deep-Core, organic life is a memory, replaced by the relentless blue glow of Cherenkov radiation. Here, time is measured in half-lives, and every breath is filtered through a thousand layers of lead.

civilizations.name: The Lead-Bound Hegemony
civilizations.summary: A civilization of radiation-hardened cyborgs and remnant intelligences existing within the lead-lined corridors of the Gamma Hold. They view the lethal isotopes of Aura-507 as a sacred burden and a source of absolute power, maintaining the station with a focus on structural integrity and containment at all costs.

taboos: Exposing organic life to raw radiation
The wasting of spent fuel rods

civilizations.name: The Flux-Weavers of Gamma
civilizations.summary: A high-precision society of bio-mechanical constructs and radiation-hardened specialists residing within the lead-lined halls of the Gamma Hold. They are defined by their incredible dexterity, required to manipulate unstable isotopes and maintain the station's integrity where any clumsy movement could trigger a terminal meltdown.
